subject: math
cluster: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes by properties of their lines and angles

steps: A ray starts at one point and goes on forever in one direction.
solution.answer: A part of a line with one endpoint that goes on forever in one direction

items.prompt: How is a line segment different from a line?

steps: A line goes on forever in both directions.
A line segment has two endpoints and does not go on forever.
solution.answer: A segment has two endpoints; a line goes forever both ways.

items.prompt: What do two rays sharing an endpoint form?

steps: Two rays from the same point form an angle.
The shared point is the vertex.
They stay the same distance apart.
Perpendicular lines cross at a right angle ($90^\circ$).
solution.answer: Lines that cross at a right angle

items.prompt: How many endpoints does a line segment have?

steps: A segment has endpoints on both ends.
